title: Highlights: Tatum, Hines and Ellington
summary: He names playing with Tatum, Earl Hines and Duke Ellington as highlights.

story.theme_name: Duke Ellington and his orchestra, as others knew them
story.community_name: Duke Ellington: the band, the man, his men

blocks.x: What would you say are some of the highlights of your career?
I played with three of the greatest pianists in the world. That was Art Tatum, Earl Hines, Duke Ellington. I never played with Teddy Wilson. I tried to, you know, but I mean I did that.
